state_encoding.integer_encoding: cell i is bits 4*i through 4*i+3; bit 0 is the integer LSB
state_encoding.matrix_encoding: cells 0..15 are row-major in a 4x4 matrix
state_encoding.hex_encoding: a state is a 16-hex-digit integer in the integer encoding above

skinny64_128.add_constants: For round constant rc, XOR rc&0xf into cell 0, (rc>>4)&0x3 into cell 4, and 0x2 into cell 8.
skinny64_128.add_round_tweakey: XOR TK1[i] xor TK2[i] into state cell i for i=0..7 only.

tweakey_schedule.round_update_order: After each round, permute both components. Then apply LFSR2 to cells 0..7 of the permuted TK2; TK1 has no LFSR.
tweakey_schedule.lfsr2: For a nibble with little-endian bits (x0,x1,x2,x3), output little-endian bits (x2 xor x3, x0, x1, x2).
tweakey_schedule.round_indexing: Round 0 uses the unmodified initial components.

subcipher.input_boundary: X9, immediately before SubCells of round 9
subcipher.output_boundary: X17, immediately after MixColumns of round 16

both_shifted.name: K11
both_shifted.construction: K00 xor the upper and lower component differences

joint_event.random_variables: X and Xprime are independent uniform 64-bit states at X9.
event_definition: For every round 9..16, immediately after SubCells, require A0 xor A1 = B0 xor B1.
At X17, require A0 xor A1 = output_difference and B0 xor B1 = output_difference.
joint_event.target_probability: q(TK1,TK2) is the probability of this event over independent uniform X and Xprime, with K00 fixed by the base 128-bit tweakey.
